sections.title: How the population has changed in Peterborough
sections.label: Select another local authority

sections.content: In 2024, Peterborough was the fourth largest local authority in the East of England, with a population of just over 220,000. Its population increased by 1.1% compared with 2023, and has increased by 42.1% since 2001.

sections.title: Largest local authorities in the East of England, 2001-2024
Population density in Peterborough
sections.content: In 2024, the population density in Peterborough was 651 people per square kilometre, which was more than the East of England (344), and more than the United Kingdom as a whole (285).

sections.title: Densest local authorities in the East of England, 2024
Median age in Peterborough
sections.content: In 2024, the median age in Peterborough was 36 years, which was younger than the East of England (41 years), and younger than the United Kingdom as a whole (40 years).
